name: Electric Scalp Massager with 4 Clusters | Rechargeable & Full-Body Relaxation
description:
The Electric Scalp Massager is designed with 4 moveable massage clusters and soft silicone heads to deliver soothing relief and relaxation. Rechargeable, portable, and washable, it can be used on the scalp, shoulders, neck, back, arms, and more. Ideal for boosting blood circulation, reducing stress, and supporting hair health.
Key Features
 4 moveable massage clusters for deep relaxation
 Soft silicone heads, skin-friendly & washable
 Helps relieve stress, fatigue, and hair loss
 Rechargeable and portable for daily use
 Multi-functional – scalp, neck, shoulders, and back
 Perfect for personal care or gifting
Ingredients / Materials
ABS plastic, Silicone massage heads, Rechargeable battery
How to Use
 Charge the device fully before first use
 Turn on the massager using the power button
 Gently place on scalp or body and move in circular motions
 Use daily for 5–10 minutes for best results
Package Includes
 1 × Electric Scalp Massager
 1 × Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
